# fkr

**fkr** generates realistic-looking, made-up (fake) data for the
Philippines – names, addresses, phone numbers, ages, job titles,
ID-style numbers, and more – for building and testing software, writing
tutorials, or teaching, **without using any real person’s information.**

Nothing this package produces is looked up from a real database. Every
value – including anything formatted to look like a government ID number
(SSS, TIN, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, PhilSys) – is randomly made up on the
spot. It does not belong to any real person, business, or record, and
won’t work anywhere official.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("yng-me/fkr")
```

## Quick start

Every function starts with `fkr_`. The first thing you tell it is always
**how many fake values you want**:

``` r

library(fkr)

fkr_full_name(3)
#> [1] "Tanisha Magsino" "Socorro Cunanan" "Joyce Alcantara"
fkr_age(3)
#> [1]  2 50  1
fkr_mobile_number(3)
#> [1] "09910021516" "09187189635" "09489378455"
fkr_address(3)
#>                       street   barangay        city         province
#> 1         464 Legarda Avenue San Isidro Iligan City  Lanao del Norte
#> 2        366 Recto Extension   Maligaya Butuan City Agusan del Norte
#> 3 342 Shaw Boulevard Highway      Tibig   Las Piñas     Metro Manila
#>                          region  zip
#> 1  Region X (Northern Mindanao) 9200
#> 2          Region XIII (Caraga) 8600
#> 3 National Capital Region (NCR) 1740
```

Want a whole pretend dataset – many columns, many rows – in one go? Use
[`fkr()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr.md) and list which
generator fills each column:

``` r

fkr(5, list(
  first_name = fkr_first_name,
  last_name = fkr_last_name,
  sex = fkr_sex,
  age = fkr_age,
  date_of_birth = fkr_birthday
))
#>   first_name last_name    sex age date_of_birth
#> 1     Jordan  Abubakar Female   6    2020-10-07
#> 2       Iris  Gonzales   Male   6    2020-02-28
#> 3     Editha Dela Cruz   Male   6    2020-07-12
#> 4     Warren Natividad   Male   5    2021-07-25
#> 5    Loretta   Mahinay   Male  15    2011-10-13
```

`age` and `date_of_birth` automatically agree with each other – fkr
makes sure a person’s birthdate actually matches the age shown for them.

For a friendlier, step-by-step walkthrough (including how to attach
extra settings to a column, or make one column depend on another), see
`vignette("fkr")` after installing.

## What can it generate?

| Category | Examples |
|----|----|
| People | first/last/full name, sex, civil status, age, birthday |
| Contact details | email, mobile number, landline number |
| Addresses | region, province, city, barangay, street address, ZIP code, full address |
| Government ID-style numbers | SSS, TIN, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, PhilSys (see disclaimer above) |
| Official PH classifications | PSGC geographic codes, PSOC occupations, PSIC industries |
| Business | company name, job title, industry, product, price, business permit number |
| General-purpose helpers | plain numbers, whole numbers, yes/no, “select all that apply”, labeled categories, unique IDs, coordinates |
| Whole datasets | [`fkr()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr.md) – build a complete fake table in one call |

Every function has its own help page with more detail and examples, e.g.
[`?fkr_address`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_address.md).

## A note on realism

Names, surnames, addresses, and job titles are drawn from real
Philippine reference data where possible (e.g. actual
region/province/city names, and the official PSGC, PSOC, and PSIC
classification systems), so the *shape* of the data is realistic – but
the specific combination assigned to any one fake record is always
random and fictional.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`fkr()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr.md) : Generate a
  complete fake dataset
- [`fkr_address()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_address.md)
  : Generate complete, internally-consistent Philippine addresses
- [`fkr_age()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_age.md) :
  Generate ages
- [`fkr_barangay()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_barangay.md)
  : Generate barangay names
- [`fkr_binary()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_binary.md)
  : Generate binary (0/1) values
- [`fkr_birthday()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_birthday.md)
  : Generate birthdates
- [`fkr_birthday_split()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_birthday_split.md)
  : Generate birthdates as separate year/month/day components
- [`fkr_boolean()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_boolean.md)
  : Generate boolean values
- [`fkr_business_permit_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_business_permit_number.md)
  : Generate business/mayor's permit-style numbers
- [`fkr_city()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_city.md) :
  Generate Philippine cities/municipalities
- [`fkr_civil_status()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_civil_status.md)
  : Generate civil status
- [`fkr_company()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_company.md)
  : Generate company names
- [`fkr_company_suffix()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_company_suffix.md)
  : Generate company suffixes
- [`fkr_coordinates()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_coordinates.md)
  : Generate Philippine latitude/longitude coordinates
- [`fkr_department()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_department.md)
  : Generate company department names
- [`fkr_email()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_email.md) :
  Generate email addresses
- [`fkr_factor()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_factor.md)
  : Generate a factor variable with value labels and an optional
  variable label
- [`fkr_first_name()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_first_name.md)
  : Generate Filipino first names
- [`fkr_full_name()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_full_name.md)
  : Generate full Filipino names
- [`fkr_industry()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_industry.md)
  : Generate industry names
- [`fkr_int()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_int.md) :
  Generate whole numbers
- [`fkr_job_title()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_job_title.md)
  : Generate job titles
- [`fkr_landline_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_landline_number.md)
  : Generate Philippine landline numbers
- [`fkr_last_name()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_last_name.md)
  : Generate Filipino last names (surnames)
- [`fkr_mobile_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_mobile_number.md)
  : Generate Philippine mobile numbers
- [`fkr_multiple_response()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_multiple_response.md)
  : Generate multiple-response (select-all-that-apply) values
- [`fkr_num()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_num.md) :
  Generate numbers
- [`fkr_pagibig_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_pagibig_number.md)
  : Generate Pag-IBIG (HDMF) number-style identifiers
- [`fkr_philhealth_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_philhealth_number.md)
  : Generate PhilHealth number-style identifiers
- [`fkr_philsys_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_philsys_number.md)
  : Generate PhilSys Number (PSN) card-style identifiers
- [`fkr_price()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_price.md) :
  Generate prices in Philippine pesos
- [`fkr_product()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_product.md)
  : Generate product names
- [`fkr_province()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_province.md)
  : Generate Philippine provinces
- [`fkr_psgc_code()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_psgc_code.md)
  : Generate Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC) codes
- [`fkr_psic_industry()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_psic_industry.md)
  : Generate PSIC-classified industries
- [`fkr_psoc_occupation()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_psoc_occupation.md)
  : Generate PSOC-classified occupations
- [`fkr_region()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_region.md)
  : Generate Philippine regions
- [`fkr_seed()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_seed.md) :
  Seed fkr's random number generation
- [`fkr_sex()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_sex.md) :
  Generate biological sex
- [`fkr_sss_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_sss_number.md)
  : Generate SSS number-style identifiers
- [`fkr_street_address()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_street_address.md)
  : Generate street addresses
- [`fkr_tin_number()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_tin_number.md)
  : Generate TIN-style identifiers
- [`fkr_uuid()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_uuid.md) :
  Generate UUIDs
- [`fkr_zip_code()`](https://yng-me.github.io/fkr/reference/fkr_zip_code.md)
  : Generate Philippine ZIP codes
